description_expanded: 30A ESCAPESpresents...“Villages of South Walton B324”, a top-floor retreat in Seacrest Beach. Wake up to the buzz of Peddler’s Pavilion, sip coffee on your balcony, and soak in the charm below. This 3-bedroom haven is perfect for making memories. Lounge by TWO pools, explore 30A on 4 included bikes, or take the seasonal tram for easy beach access. From morning rides to sunset strolls and live music at Peddler's Pavilion, adventure and relaxation await. Learn more below!*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Steps to 2 Community Pools – Dive into relaxation with easy access to two sparkling pools, including one heated for those cooler days.Shops & Live Entertainment – Soak up the vibrant energy with views of bustling shops and lively entertainment at Peddler's Pavilion right from your balcony.Seasonal Tram Access to the Beach – Enjoy effortless trips to the stunning beach with seasonal tram service, leaving you more time to feel the sand between your toes.4 Beach Bikes Included for Scenic Rides – Cruise along picturesque paths and take in the coastal beauty with the provided beach bikes, perfect for exploring in style.Fully Equipped Kitchen & Washer/Dryer – Feel at home with convenient amenities, making your stay stress-free and comfortable.Walk to Rosemary Beach & Alys Beach – Immerse yourself in charming, walkable communities filled with unique character, stunning architecture, and endless charm.Family-Friendly Area with Splash Pad & Dining – Create cherished memories with loved ones in this family-oriented area featuring fun splash pads, grilling area and a variety of delicious dining options.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "The condo looked just like the pictures. Clean, comfortable, and plenty of space for the family. Perfect location for biking and enjoying local restaurants!" – Jamie G.⭐ "We LOVED the bikes, the location, and the swimming pool! Super cute restaurants in the area and a perfect-sized condo for our group." – Janene H.⭐ "Could not have picked a better location! Easy walk to Rosemary Beach and the tram to the beach was the icing on the cake!" – Mackenzie G.*** LIVING AREAS ***Relax and unwind in the bright, open living area that’s perfect for gathering. Large windows and French doors bring in natural light and lead to the private balcony, where you can enjoy stunning views and fresh air.Bright and Spacious Living AreaSmart TV & Comfortable SeatingBalcony Access with Scenic Views and Outdoor Dining for 4*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Feel right at home with a fully equipped kitchen, modern appliances, and plenty of space for cooking or enjoying meals with family. The dining table seats 6, with additional seating at the breakfast bar for 3.Fully Equipped Kitchen with Modern AppliancesDining Table Seating for 6 + Breakfast Bar for 3Coffee Maker, Stove, Dishwasher & More*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***This condo comfortably sleeps 7 guests across 3 beautifully appointed bedrooms. Each room features premium bedding and a flat-screen TV for relaxing after a day of adventure.Primary King Suite: King Bed, Flat-screen TV with access to the shared balcony and en-suite Bathroom with Walk-In Shower and separate Soaking TubQueen Guest Suite: Queen Bed, Closet, Flat-screen TV with private access to the shared BathroomBunk Room: Twin Bunk Bed, Closet, Flat-screen TV with shared BathroomHallway Bathroom: Full size bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY AMENITIES ***Enjoy everything The Villages of South Walton has to offer! Perfectly located between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, this vibrant community provides easy access to boutique shopping, gourmet dining, outdoor activities, and more—all just steps away.Peddler’s Pavilion Shops & Dining – Just steps away! Enjoy a lively atmosphere with boutique shops, delicious eats, and a vibrant community vibe right at your doorstep.Rosemary Beach – A quick 4-minute walk. Stroll through charming cobblestone streets, lush greenery, and experience a quaint, upscale beach town ambiance.Alys Beach – A 12-minute walk. Discover stunning white architecture, laid-back luxury, and serene vibes perfect for a peaceful escape.Zero-Entry Pool & Splash Pad for Kids – Family-friendly fun with safe, shallow waters and exciting water play for the little ones.Heated Pool & Hot Tub (Seasonally Heated) – Relax in warmth and comfort, whether you're swimming or soaking under a clear sky.Poolside Grilling Stations – Savor the joy of outdoor cooking while lounging by the pool.On-Site Shopping & Dining Options – Ultimate convenience with everything you need just steps away!*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in quotes but can be added at checkout.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 211430
